correctness.rationale: For the triangle C3, all six vertex-edge incidences form a nine-edge prism graph, with no acyclic triple matching: M(C3)=C3□K2. Independently enumerated all 4096 prism vertex local choices, rejecting duplicate edges/directed cycles; got 1727 nonempty faces f=(18,126,428,705,450). Replayed 18 ordered matching stages obtaining 828 pairs, one 0-cell, three 3-cells and 67 4-cells; verified acyclic orientation over 6606 Hasse covers and mod-2 boundary ranks (17,109,319,386). Independently recomputed signed integral projection recursively for all critical 4-cells; columns 0,17,28 equal standard degree basis of Z3, on masks 26692,42272,84036. Since π3(wedge^3 S3)=Z3, these three 4-cells kill the three 3-spheres via an integer unimodular degree matrix; residual 64 4-cell attachments then nullhomotopic, giving wedge^64 S4, not only mod-2 rank.
